name: relations
source: 任鐵樵《滴天髓闡微》 (刑之义无所取 ... 子刑卯，卯刑子，是谓相生，何以相刑？ ... 故称三刑，又有自刑，此皆俗谬，姑置之。 ... 且刑既不足为凭，而害之义，尤为穿凿。), read on 2026-10-13 at zh.wikisource.org/wiki/滴天髓闡微.
notes: 任鐵樵 holds that punishments have no basis and harms still less, and sets both aside: by this table a chart has neither. Clashes, harmonies and trines stand as everywhere. Checked against a transcription, not a printed edition.
